design_goal: Expand sound-producing human action and identity diversity while preserving clear single-view reconstruction cues.

reference.paper: Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models
reference.visual_pattern: Standalone human sources with visible sound-related objects and actions, later placed into simulated indoor scenes.

shared_generation_constraints.framing: complete person and complete sound-related object visible inside a 1024x1024 frame
shared_generation_constraints.camera: three-quarter front or three-quarter side view selected to expose the action-object relation
shared_generation_constraints.reconstruction: clear connected foreground silhouette with useful separation between limbs, torso and prop
shared_generation_constraints.runtime_target: static semantic GLB without required rig or animation

baseline_retention.note: Visual identity similarity is a dataset diversity limitation, not a semantic rejection reason. V2 variants supplement these approved baselines and must use distinct asset IDs and output directories.

reuse_existing.reason: The approved v1 singer is already female and has a strong open-mouth singing pose with a handheld microphone.
